title: A Gift of Meaningful Viewing
intro: A small, carefully selected collection of meaningful, educational and family-friendly films, animations and documentaries from the Shia Resource Hub video material.

items.name: Sulaiman aur Luqman
items.description: A children's story series presented in the source material as a way to learn basic Islamic manners, character and neighbourliness.
items.whySelected: A gentle starting point for children and families.
items.sourceNote: Source material lists Dailymotion, Aparat and YouTube search access; this page uses a YouTube search destination rather than claiming a verified direct upload.

items.name: Safar-e-Ishq
items.description: A 2D animated presentation of Karbala, the trials of the children and Ahlul Haram, and the journey toward Kufa and Shaam, described in the source material as being made for children.
items.whySelected: A meaningful historical story presented in an accessible animated format.
items.sourceNote: Source material lists Dailymotion, YouTube and ShiaTV search access.

items.name: Shah-e-Khurasan
items.description: A 2D animation about the well-known account of Imam Ali Raza (A.S) and the deer, described in the source material as a child-friendly presentation.
items.whySelected: A simple way to introduce a historical Ahlulbayt story to children.
items.sourceNote: Source material lists YouTube, Aparat and ShiaTV search access.

items.name: Princess of Rome
items.description: A 3D animated historical film about Bibi Nargis Khatoon, described in the source material as covering her journey from Rome to her marriage with Imam Hasan al-Askari (A.S).
items.whySelected: A visually engaging historical story for family viewing.
items.sourceNote: Source material lists Dailymotion, ShiaTV and YouTube search access.

items.name: Filshah / The Elephant King
items.description: An animated retelling of the account of the elephant army and the events associated with the Kaaba, described as a child-friendly and moral presentation.
items.whySelected: A family-friendly way to explore a well-known Qur'anic-era story.
items.sourceNote: Source material lists YouTube, Aparat and Dailymotion access.

items.name: Children of Heaven
items.description: The story of siblings Ali and Zahra sharing one pair of shoes, presented in the source material as a lesson in dignity, love, patience and gratitude.
items.whySelected: A strong family film centered on character and compassion.
items.sourceNote: Source material lists Aparat, ShiaTV, YouTube and Dailymotion search access.

items.name: The Color of Paradise
items.description: A story about a blind child and his father, described in the source material as encouraging gratitude and seeing blessings beyond physical sight.
items.whySelected: A thoughtful family film with a strong emotional and moral theme.
items.sourceNote: Source material lists Aparat, YouTube and Dailymotion search access.

items.name: Gold and Copper
items.description: A story of a Hawza student balancing religious study, family responsibilities and his wife's illness, described in the source material as a story of patience and devotion.
items.whySelected: For older viewers looking for a reflective family and faith-centered story.
items.sourceNote: Source material lists Aparat, ShiaTV and YouTube search access.

items.name: Science in Islam / Islamic Golden Age
items.description: A documentary-style learning topic about the Islamic Golden Age and Muslim scholars such as Al-Khwarizmi and Ibn Sina, as described in the source material.
items.whySelected: A useful bridge between Islamic history and curiosity about science and learning.
items.sourceNote: Source material lists YouTube and Dailymotion search access.
